name: io.github.ohneben/activecampaign-mcp
description: ActiveCampaign MCP server — the full account API (v3 + SMS + WhatsApp + Segments, ~325 endpoints) as safety-categorized tools (Docker + Streamable HTTP).

environmentVariables.name: ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your account's API URL, copied from ActiveCampaign -> Settings -> Developer, e.g. https://your-account.api-us1.com/api/3

environmentVariables.name: ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your ActiveCampaign API token (same Developer screen).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Required whenever HOST is not a loopback address, otherwise the server refuses to start.
